name: claude-image-generation
description: Generate and edit images using Google Gemini, OpenAI GPT Image, xAI Grok Image, and OpenRouter APIs

defaultProviders.title: Default providers
defaultProviders.description: Which providers the generate tool runs when a call names none. "all" runs gemini, openai and xai in parallel; openrouter is opt-in.

outputDir.title: Output directory
outputDir.description: Where the generate tool saves images when a call gives no outputBase, relative to the session's working directory.
